summary: Opened PR #26 with docs/plans/issue-9-fix-dead-links.md, an implementation plan covering all 24 href="#" anchors (social icons -> verified owner destinations with aria-labels; 9 project cards -> their own full-res images, zero CSS churn; 6 blog cards -> de-anchored with line-cited CSS rename; 6 client logos unwrapped).
